gloss: to return home; to come home; to go home

definitions.gloss: to return home; to come home; to go home
definitions.explanation: To go back to one's home, especially after work, school, or going out. Refers specifically to returning to one's own residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰宅|きたく}した。
examples.english: I came home in the evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰宅|きたく}する。
examples.english: My father always comes home late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧{帰宅|きたく}する⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧です。
examples.english: Once work is over, I plan to go straight home.

notes:
Refers specifically to returning to one's own home or residence, as opposed to simply going back somewhere. More formal and precise than ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ — time of returning home
- ⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ — on the way home
- ⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ — after returning home
- ⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ — to come home late

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ — the general everyday word for going home; less formal
- {帰還|きかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to return (from far away, e.g., from overseas or war); literary
- ⟦{帰省|きせい}→帰省：12419_kisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to return to one's hometown or parents' home
